body:
Source: repo-bloat review (rev-tests finding 1 & 2, issue #1043). `packages/lesson-foundry/test/cli.test.mjs`, `foundry.test.mjs`, `stable-cluster-id.test.mjs`, and `write-preserve-existing.test.mjs` manually invoke `mkdtempSync` and guard removals in 45 `try/finally` blocks, and are allowlisted in `scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs`. With `@adlc/core/test-kit` (`tmp`), fixture directories automatically register cleanup via `t.after` when passed the test context `t`.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. In `packages/lesson-foundry/test/cli.test.mjs`:
   - Import `{ tmp }` from `@adlc/core/test-kit`.
   - Update test declarations using temp directories to accept the `t` parameter.
   - Replace `makeTempDir()` with `tmp(t, 'lesson-foundry-cli-test-')`.
   - Remove all `try { ... } finally { rmSync(dir, ...); }` blocks, unindenting the test bodies.
   - Delete the local `function makeTempDir()` helper.
2. In `packages/lesson-foundry/test/foundry.test.mjs`:
   - Import `{ tmp }` from `@adlc/core/test-kit`.
   - Update test declarations using temp directories to accept the `t` parameter.
   - Replace `makeTempDir()` with `tmp(t, 'lesson-foundry-test-')`.
   - Remove all `try { ... } finally { rmSync(dir, ...); }` blocks, unindenting the test bodies.
   - Delete the local `function makeTempDir()` helper.
3. In `packages/lesson-foundry/test/stable-cluster-id.test.mjs`:
   - Import `{ tmp }` from `@adlc/core/test-kit`.
   - Update test declarations using temp directories to accept the `t` parameter.
   - Replace `makeTempDir()` with `tmp(t, 'lesson-foundry-stable-id-')`.
   - Remove all `try { ... } finally { rmSync(dir, ...); }` blocks, unindenting the test bodies.
   - Delete the local `function makeTempDir()` helper.
4. In `packages/lesson-foundry/test/write-preserve-existing.test.mjs`:
   - Import `{ tmp }` from `@adlc/core/test-kit`.
   - Update test declarations using temp directories to accept the `t` parameter.
   - Replace `makeTempDir()` with `tmp(t, 'lesson-foundry-write-preserve-')`.
   - Remove all `try { ... } finally { rmSync(dir, ...); }` blocks, unindenting the test bodies.
   - Delete the local `function makeTempDir()` helper.
5. In `scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs`:
   - Remove `'packages/lesson-foundry/test/cli.test.mjs'`, `'packages/lesson-foundry/test/foundry.test.mjs'`, `'packages/lesson-foundry/test/stable-cluster-id.test.mjs'`, and `'packages/lesson-foundry/test/write-preserve-existing.test.mjs'` from the `ALLOWLIST` set.
6. Verification:
   - `npm test -w packages/lesson-foundry` exits 0 with all 140 tests passing.
   - `node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs` exits 0.
   - `grep -c 'finally' packages/lesson-foundry/test/cli.test.mjs packages/lesson-foundry/test/foundry.test.mjs packages/lesson-foundry/test/stable-cluster-id.test.mjs packages/lesson-foundry/test/write-preserve-existing.test.mjs` outputs 0, 0, 0, 0.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 `grep -c 'finally' packages/lesson-foundry/test/cli.test.mjs packages/lesson-foundry/test/foundry.test.mjs packages/lesson-foundry/test/stable-cluster-id.test.mjs packages/lesson-foundry/test/write-preserve-existing.test.mjs` reports 0, 0, 0, 0.
- AC2 None of the 4 test files define a local `makeTempDir` helper.
- AC3 `grep -E 'packages/lesson-foundry/test/' scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs` returns nothing.
- AC4 `npm test -w packages/lesson-foundry` exits 0 with all tests passing.
- AC5 `node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs` exits 0.
- AC6 `adlc rails-guard` exits 0.
title: refactor(lesson-foundry): adopt @adlc/core/test-kit and eliminate 45 try/finally blocks in lesson-foundry tests
